interactive.label: Load…
interactive.tooltip: Load a parameter network from a GraphML (.gml) file and apply its values, fixed flags and links to the fits.

interactive.label: Save…
interactive.tooltip: Save the current parameter network to a GraphML (.gml) file.

interactive.label: Refresh
interactive.tooltip: Rebuild the network from the current fits and links, and lay it out again. The button to reach for when the picture disagrees with the fits.

interactive.label: auto
interactive.tooltip: Redraw when a fit or a link changes. Changes are coalesced and the layout only re-runs when the network's shape changed, so a running fit costs nothing here. Untick to refresh by hand.

interactive.label: Link
interactive.tooltip: Link the two selected parameters: the first one selected is the master, the second follows it.

interactive.label: Unlink
interactive.tooltip: Remove the links of the selected parameters (of every parameter, with 'all').

interactive.label: all
interactive.tooltip: Unlink applies to EVERY parameter in every fit, not just the selection.

interactive.label: Fit view
interactive.tooltip: Fit the graph back into the panel: undoes zoom, pan and any nodes you dragged.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the window, one control at a time.
What the Global View shows and how links work.
